First, we selected children with a nonmissing weight value
who remained in the same school with the same teacher throughout kinder-
garten and who had complete sociodemographic data as well as both fall
and spring literacy assessments and teacher ratings of their literacy skills.
We then selected teachers with full background information who had pro-
vided information about their classrooms. Finally, we selected schools
with a nonmissing weight that enrolled at least three ECLS-K children. Our
final analytic sample includes a diverse group of 9,493 children within
1,822 classrooms, which are nested within 701 public and private schools.
